notes.title: Huge update 09/02/2021
notes.content:
Massive updates all around...

- gameplay bug fixes.
- invisible walls have been fixed except for the forest areas.
- new areas.
-crashes with ue4 fixed.
- added new people to credits. Missed out on a few people from Russia. 
- one new achievement, more to come.
- right now the game sits at 14gb but will be slimmed down back to around six gb when the rest of the new updates role out.

Thank you all for the continued support
Happy gaming to all.
